```plato
    //==
    // # ISupport2D / ISupport3D
    //
    // The support mapping returns the farthest point of a convex shape in a given
    // direction (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Support_function). SupportExtent
    // projects that point onto the direction, giving the signed extent of the
    // shape along it — the scalar GJK / SAT actually consume.
    // A `var` local fetches the support point once (LIBRARIES.md permits var locals
    // in statement bodies) instead of re-evaluating Support per component.

    // The signed extent of the shape along `direction`: the support point projected
    // onto the (unit) direction vector.
    SupportExtent(self: ISupport2D, direction: Direction2D): Number
    {
        var p = self.Support(direction);
        return p.X * direction.Vector.X + p.Y * direction.Vector.Y;
    }
```

```plato
    // The signed extent of the shape along `direction`: the support point projected
    // onto the (unit) direction vector.
    SupportExtent(self: ISupport3D, direction: Direction3D): Number
    {
        var p = self.Support(direction);
        return p.X * direction.Vector.X + p.Y * direction.Vector.Y + p.Z * direction.Vector.Z;
    }
}
```
